strains.name: Normal
strains.blurb: The classic multicoloured guppy. Hardy and cheerful.

strains.name: Red
strains.blurb: Bright red all over. Mixes well with yellow, blue and white.

strains.name: Yellow
strains.blurb: Sunny yellow. Try it with red or black.

strains.name: Blue
strains.blurb: Deep blue. A good partner for red, grass or Normal guppies.

strains.name: White
strains.blurb: Clean and pale. Brings out soft colours in its babies.

strains.name: Black
strains.blurb: Inky black. The key to many patterned varieties.

strains.name: Grass
strains.blurb: Fresh green. Pairs with blue or black.

strains.name: Orange
strains.blurb: A bred colour, sold as breeding stock.

strains.name: Koi
strains.blurb: White with orange patches, like a tiny koi carp.

strains.name: Tuxedo
strains.blurb: Dressed for dinner: a dark back half and a bright front.

strains.name: Neon
strains.blurb: Electric colours that glow under the tank light.

strains.name: Albino
strains.blurb: Pale with ruby eyes. Only ever appears by mutation.
